ArrivalConfig.description: Arrival-rate configuration (`arrival:`) — an open load model: the engine holds an iterations-per-second profile and scales a worker pool to keep up, instead of looping a fixed set of VUs.

max_vus.description: Hard cap on the worker pool — must be ≥ 1. A permit that arrives while all `max_vus` workers are busy is dropped and counted in the `dropped_iterations` metric. Effectively required: the default (0) is rejected at validation time.

pre_allocated_vus.description: Workers spawned at run start (default 1). The pool grows lazily up to `max_vus` while permits arrive faster than the pool can serve them.

stages.description: Rate profile: ramp the arrival rate linearly to each stage's `rate` over its `duration`. The first stage ramps from 0 iterations/sec.

anyOf.description: Network egress restricted to an allowlist of destination hosts.

Capability.description: A capability grant in a `libraries:` entry (RFC 005 capability model).

EngineMetricsConfig.description:
Engine self-observability for a run (`engine_metrics:` next to `vus`/`duration`).

Off by default; set `enabled: true` to probe scheduler lag and run-log channel depth every `interval_ms` for the duration of the VU phase.

Unknown keys are rejected (`deny_unknown_fields`) — a typo'd key must fail at load time instead of silently leaving the section at defaults.

enabled.description: Master switch. When `false` the whole section is ignored and no probe task is spawned.

interval_ms.description: Probe interval in milliseconds (default 100, minimum 10). The scheduler-lag reading is measured against this interval, so it is also the resolution of the lag histogram.

GitImport.description: `import: { git, ref, file }` — fetch `file` from `git` at `ref`.

file.description: Path of the YAML document inside the repository.

ref.description: Tag, branch, or commit SHA. Tags/SHAs cache forever; branches revalidate against the remote after a short TTL.

GpuConfig.description:
GPU metrics collection for a run (`gpu:` next to `vus`/`duration`).

Off by default; set `enabled: true` to sample every GPU (or the `devices` subset) for the duration of the VU phase. Failures are non-fatal: one warning is logged and the run continues without GPU metrics.

Unknown keys are rejected (`deny_unknown_fields`) — a typo'd key must fail at load time instead of silently leaving the section at defaults.

dcgm_url.description: dcgm-exporter metrics endpoint, used with `source: dcgm`.

devices.description: Restrict sampling to these GPU indices (default: all devices the source reports).

enabled.description: Master switch. When `false` the whole section is ignored.

source.description: Collector source: `nvidia-smi` (default), `dcgm`, or `powermetrics` (Apple Silicon, macOS only — needs root, see docs). Downstream crates may register additional names via [`register_gpu_collector`].

anyOf.description: A relative filesystem path, or an `http(s)://` URL with the ref already pinned in the path.
A file at a ref of an arbitrary git remote (SSH or HTTPS).

ImportSpec.description: The value of a top-level `import:` key.

InputDecl.description: One declared input (`inputs.<name>`). Short form (`users: number`) is just the type; the long form adds `default`, `min`/`max` (number only) and `options` (choice only).

InputSpec.description: The long form of an input declaration.

default.description: Default value; when absent the input is required (a value must come from `-i` or the env file).

InputType.description: The declared type of one input.

oneOf.description: A boolean. String values coerce: `0`/`false` → false, `1`/`true` → true; anything else is an error.
One of a fixed option list (GitHub Actions style `choice`).

LibraryRef.description:
One `libraries:` entry — a value-generator library bound to a token alias.

Unknown keys are rejected (`deny_unknown_fields`): a typo'd policy key (`capabilties:`, `allows:`) must fail loudly — silently dropping it would weaken the fail-closed capability model.

allow.description: Whitelist of callable functions (`${alias.fn(...)}`). When present, calling a function not listed fails the step. `deny:` wins over `allow:` when a name appears in both.

as.description: Token alias — `${alias.fn(...)}`. Default: the library's name part (`random` for `@std/random@v1`). Must be a lowercase identifier and unique across all declared libraries.

capabilities.description:
Explicit capability grants, fail-closed: any non-empty grant requires `allow_library_capabilities: true` in the config. `fs` / `clock` / `process` are bare strings; network egress is an object with a host allowlist (`net: ["api.example.com"]`) — raw sockets are never granted. `process` (RFC 009) additionally requires `allow_process_actions: true` in the config.

**Required key.** Serde keeps the field optional only so a missing key yields a targeted validation error (see [`require_explicit_capabilities`]) instead of a generic schema complaint: declare `capabilities: []` explicitly when the library needs no grants — omitting the key is an error.

deny.description: Blacklist of functions that must not be called; a call fails the step. Wins over `allow:`.

log.description: Functions whose results are always masked in the run log (same effect as the function declaring `secret: true` in `info()`, but decided by the config author).

secret.description: Mark **every** result of this library as secret: each value a call returns is recorded in the run's secret registry and masked (`***`) in the run log. Additive on top of function-level `secret` flags — there is deliberately no way to *un*mask.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the artifact (64 lowercase hex characters). Required for `https://` sources — `perfscale install` refuses to fetch without it and a mismatch with the fetched bytes is a hard error. Optional for `git+` sources (the commit pin in `perfscale.lock` is the integrity anchor); when present it is verified against the fetched artifact.

use.description:
Library reference:

- `@std/random@v1`, `@std/json@v1` — built-in, native; - a local `.wasm` path — WASM component, relative to the declaring file's directory (resolved by `import:` handling; requires a build with the `wasm-libs` feature, which the CLI enables); - `https://…/lib.wasm` — fetched by `perfscale install`; requires `sha256:` and is pinned in `perfscale.lock`; - `git+<repo-url>@<ref>#<path>` — a `.wasm` artifact inside a git repository at a tag/branch/commit, fetched by `perfscale install` and pinned to the resolved commit in `perfscale.lock`.

Remote sources are resolved to the local cache at load time, so `run`/`lint` stay fully offline.

with.description: JSON config handed to the library at instantiation (`with:`). May use `${{ env.X }}` like any other parameter block.

RateStage.description: One `arrival.stages:` entry — ramp the arrival rate linearly to `rate` over `duration`.

rate.description: Iterations per second to reach by the end of the stage. Fractions are allowed (`0.5` = one iteration every 2s); must be ≥ 0.

ReportConfig.description:
Where to forward run metrics: the aggregated summary after `perfscale run` finishes, and — with `during_run: true` — cumulative metric snapshots while the run is in progress. See [crate::report].

Unknown keys are rejected (`deny_unknown_fields`) — a typo'd knob (`duringrun: true`) must fail at load time, not silently disable streaming.

batch_size.description: Flush a batch once it holds this many samples (default 500).

during_run.description: Stream metric snapshots during the run (batched POSTs to the same endpoint), not just the summary at the end. Off by default.

labels.description: User labels stamped on the report's run identity.

max_cpu_percent.description: CPU gate for during-run shipping: while the host's busy CPU% is at or above this value batches are held (no POSTs) and snapshots deferred — queued, not dropped, shipped in order once the gate opens. `0` disables the gate (default 90); off-Linux the gate is inert.

max_pending.description: Soft cap on sealed batches awaiting delivery: crossing it warns, but batches are never dropped while the run is alive (default 24).

reporters.description: End-of-run reporters (issue #9): `[{ use: "std/report/json@v1", with: { path: out.json } }]` — the same `use:`/`with:` shape as steps. Validated fail-fast at lint and before the run starts.

url.description: Base URL of a running `perfscale serve` instance, e.g. `http://localhost:7999`. May be omitted when the block exists only for `reporters`/`labels`.

ReporterWith.description: Reporter parameters. Exactly one of `path` / `url` is required.

config.description: WASM reporters only: free-form config handed to the guest's `on-report` verbatim (the `config-json` argument).

headers.description: Extra headers for the HTTP push. Values may embed `${VAR}` environment references, e.g. `Authorization: "Bearer ${TOKEN}"` — interpolated host-side at delivery, never logged.

max_samples.description: Raw per-step samples to include (default [`MAX_STORED_STEP_SAMPLES`], `0` disables the samples block).

output.description: WASM reporters only: output directory for the guest's `emit-file` writes. Default `./perfscale-report-<module-stem>`.

path.description: Write the report to this local file.

url.description: POST the report to this URL (HTTP push).

Step.description:
A single step in a test definition.

Unknown keys are rejected (`deny_unknown_fields`): a typo like `output:` (instead of `outputs:`) must fail at load time, not silently drop data.

check.description: Post-execution assertions.  Keys are assertion names; values are expected values.  Example: `{ "status": 200, "duration_ms_lt": 500 }`.

if.description: Run the step only when this condition holds (`if:` or `when:` in YAML; equivalent aliases, rejected together). Both `${{ … }}` placeholders and `${…}` generator tokens expand first, then the result is either a comparison (`a == b`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` — numeric when both sides parse as numbers) or a bare value (false when empty, `false`, `0` or `null`); clauses combine with `&&` and `||`. A skipped step produces no output, no metrics and leaves `__last__` untouched.

message.description: Custom message for `std/thresholds@v1` steps (interpolated, appended to the auto-generated violation summary). Meaningless for other actions.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in log output.

outputs.description: Variable name to store step output under for `${{ name.field }}` use.

severity.description: Gate severity for `std/thresholds@v1` steps: `fail` (default), `warn`, or `info`. Meaningless for other actions.

use.description: Action identifier, e.g. `"std/http@v1"`. Written as `use:` in YAML; `uses:` is accepted as an alias (GitHub-Actions muscle memory).

uses.description: Action identifier, e.g. `"std/http@v1"`. Written as `use:` in YAML; `uses:` is accepted as an alias (GitHub-Actions muscle memory).

when.description: Run the step only when this condition holds (`if:` or `when:` in YAML; equivalent aliases, rejected together). Both `${{ … }}` placeholders and `${…}` generator tokens expand first, then the result is either a comparison (`a == b`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=` — numeric when both sides parse as numbers) or a bare value (false when empty, `false`, `0` or `null`); clauses combine with `&&` and `||`. A skipped step produces no output, no metrics and leaves `__last__` untouched.

VuStage.description: One `stages:` entry — ramp the VU count linearly to `target` over `duration`. The first stage ramps from 0 VUs, each later stage from the previous stage's `target` (like k6's `ramping-vus` with `startVUs: 0`).

target.description: Virtual users to reach by the end of the stage. `0` is a full ramp-down: remaining VUs exit gracefully at their next step boundary.

WebRtcConfig.description: WebRTC media-plane configuration (`webrtc:`, RFC 007) — consumed by the pro `pro/webrtc-*` action module. Declaring the block on a build without the pro module is a configuration error.

ice_servers.description: STUN/TURN servers for ICE. Default (when absent): `[stun:stun.l.google.com:19302]`.

max_peer_connections.description: Optional guardrail on concurrent peer connections per engine instance: new connects fail fast with a clear error once reached. Absent = unlimited.

WebRtcIceServer.description: One STUN/TURN server entry of the `webrtc:` config block (RFC 007).

after.description: Teardown steps run **once** after the load stops — on a normal finish, on a failed run, on a failed `before`, and on Ctrl-C/SIGTERM alike. They see `${{ config.* }}` and `${{ vars.* }}` like test steps do. Unlike `before`, a failing teardown step is logged but does not abort the remaining steps (best-effort cleanup).

allow_file_actions.description: Allow filesystem-touching steps: `std/file-read@v1`, `std/read-json@v1`, `std/file-write@v1`, and `file` parts in `std/http@v1` multipart uploads. Fail-closed: defaults to `false` so a step list from an untrusted source cannot read or write arbitrary paths.

allow_library_capabilities.description: Allow `libraries:` entries to carry a non-empty `capabilities:` grant (fs/net/clock for WASM libraries, RFC 005). Fail-closed: defaults to `false`, and any grant without it is a validation error.

allow_process_actions.description: Allow process-touching steps: `std/child_process@v1` and `std/kill_process@v1`. Fail-closed: defaults to `false` so a step list from an untrusted source cannot spawn or signal OS processes.

arrival.description: Arrival-rate load profile (open model): hold an iterations-per-second rate profile, growing a worker pool up to `arrival.max_vus`. Mutually exclusive with `stages`. Native engine only. Boxed to keep `RunConfig` (and the `ExecutionPlan` enum embedding it) compact.

before.description: Setup steps run **once** before the load starts (not per VU iteration). Each step's `outputs` is exposed to test steps under the `config` namespace, e.g. a `before` step with `outputs: fix_config` is read in a test as `${{ config.fix_config.<field> }}`. If any setup step fails, the run aborts before spawning VUs.

duration.description: Duration string: `"30s"`, `"500ms"`, `"1.5s"`, `"1m"`, `"5m30s"`, `"1h"`. Sub-second values are honored by the native engine.

engine_metrics.description: Engine self-observability (`engine_metrics:`) — a probe task that records the engine's own overhead (`engine_scheduler_lag_ms`, `engine_log_channel_depth_max`) into the run metrics while the VUs run. Off by default: nothing is spawned unless `enabled: true`, so regular runs pay nothing. Native engine only. Boxed like `gpu`.

gpu.description: GPU metrics collection for the run (`gpu:`) — sample utilization, VRAM, temperature, and power every `interval_ms` while the VUs run, and land a `gpu` section in the run summary. Off by default; collection failures never fail the run. Native engine only. Boxed to keep `RunConfig` (and the `ExecutionPlan` enum embedding it) compact.

import.description: Base document to inherit from — a relative path, an `http(s)://` URL, or `{ git, ref, file }`. The base loads first (recursively), then this document deep-merges on top: objects merge, scalars/arrays here win. Remote sources require the caller's `--allow-remote-import`.

inputs.description: Typed run inputs (issue #11): `${{ inputs.<name> }}` interpolation targets with `-i key=value` CLI overrides. See [`crate::inputs`].

libraries.description: Value-generator libraries for `${alias.fn(...)}` tokens (RFC 005). Concatenates with the test file's and with imported documents' declarations; a duplicate alias is a validation error. Every entry must declare `capabilities:` (`[]` for no grants); non-empty grants require `allow_library_capabilities: true`.

max_response_body_bytes.description: Response body cap for HTTP-family steps (`std/http@v1`, `std/graphql@v1`), bytes. A larger response fails the step with a clear error (never silently truncated — a truncated JSON could pass a `check:`). Default 16 MiB, matching the WASM `net` capability cap.

seed.description: Run-level determinism seed (RFC 005): when set, every `${…}` generator and library instance derives its seed as `hash(seed, vu_id, conn_seq)`, making the run's generated values reproducible. Wall-clock time stays non-deterministic.

shared_variables.description: Shared mutable variables for `std/set_shared_variable@v1` / `std/get_shared_variable@v1`: a map of name → initial JSON value, shared by every VU of the run. Declaration is mandatory — a step referencing an undeclared name (or an op incompatible with the type inferred from the initial value) fails validation before the run starts.

stages.description: Ramping-VU load profile (k6-style): ramp the number of virtual users linearly to each stage's `target` over its `duration`. Mutually exclusive with `arrival`; when present it overrides `vus`/`duration` (total run length is the sum of stage durations). Native engine only.

variables.description: Static variables exposed to `before` and test steps under the `vars` namespace, e.g. `${{ vars.region }}`. Values may themselves be objects.

webrtc.description: WebRTC media-plane configuration (RFC 007). Requires the pro `pro/webrtc-*` action module; on builds without it, declaring this block fails validation with a "pro module required" error.
